description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named AnalyticsScreen that presents an analytics dashboard for quiz results. It includes various UI components such as KPI cards, filters, export functionality, and per-quiz performance tiles. It leverages Riverpod for state management and interacts with multiple providers to display dynamic data. The file also contains utility widgets for visualizations and user interactions.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A ConsumerWidget that builds a comprehensive analytics dashboard for quiz performance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree based on current analytics data and user interactions.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Builds the filter UI allowing category selection, date range picking, and preset filters.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter matches a specified range in days.

methods.name: _isThisWeek
methods.description: Checks if the current filter covers this week.

methods.name: _isThisMonth
methods.description: Checks if the current filter covers this month.

methods.name: _isAll
methods.description: Checks if the current filter spans the last 5 years (i.e., all data).

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Creates a choice chip for predefined day ranges.

methods.name: _weekChip
methods.description: Creates a choice chip for 'This week' preset.

methods.name: _monthChip
methods.description: Creates a choice chip for 'This month' preset.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Creates a choice chip for 'All time' preset.

methods.name: _resetChip
methods.description: Creates a chip to reset all filters to default.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Formats the selected date range into a display string.

methods.name: _onExportPressed
methods.description: Handles exporting analytics data as CSV or JSON, saving to a temporary file.

methods.name: _showSnack
methods.description: Displays a snackbar with a message.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Builds a tile widget showing per-quiz statistics including title, attempts, and score bars.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a small badge-like widget with text and colored border.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Widget shown when there is no data for current filters, with a reset button.

classes.name: KpiCard
classes.description: A widget displaying a KPI with an icon, title, and value, styled uniformly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the KPI card with styling and layout.

classes.name: SparkBar
classes.description: A visual widget representing a proportional bar for score distribution.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the spark bar with animated width based on percentage.
